title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.23256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations. The method trains a model to generate implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by their ability to predict the next chunk of text. While promising, existing evaluations primarily compare against conventional SFT baselines, leaving open whether the gains come from the RL formulation itself or from more effectively exposing the model to no-CoT data. We address this question with a controlled study of next-chunk reasoning RL and a simple but previously overlooked alternative: Mixed SFT, a single supervised fine-tuning stage that jointly trains on no-CoT and long-CoT data. translated_title: 下一块推理强化学习真的比监督微调更好吗？重新审视无思维链数据下的训练策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23256v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近期工作提出使用下一块推理强化学习来利用无思维链数据——这些语料如解题过程和教科书推导，包含丰富的推理内容但缺乏显式的思维链标注。该方法训练模型生成隐式推理轨迹，并通过其预测文本下一块的能力来奖励。尽管有前景，现有评估主要与常规监督微调基线比较，未明确增益来自强化学习本身还是更有效地向模型暴露无思维链数据。我们通过对照研究下一块推理强化学习和一个简单但先前被忽视的替代方案来解决此问题：混合监督微调，即一个联合训练无思维链和长思维链数据的单一监督微调阶段。尽管简单，混合监督微调在强化学习后验证性能上明显高于下一块推理强化学习，同时训练成本降低超过60倍。
tldr: 混合监督微调在无思维链数据下比下一块推理强化学习更有效，性能更高且训练成本降低超过60倍。
en_tdlr: Mixed SFT outperforms next-chunk reasoning RL on no-CoT data, achieving higher post-RLVR performance with over 60x less training cost.
